correctness.rationale: The pole of order 5 is prime to 3, giving a single totally ramified place, different exponent 12, genus 4 and 3-rank 0 by Riemann–Hurwitz and Deuring–Shafarevich. Tafazolian–Kazemifard Lemma 3.3 treats this exact model and full geometric automorphism group, not just the deck subgroup. The coefficient comparisons when x maps to Ax+B give A=1+2B and A^3=1+B^3, hence B=0 and A=1; the residual action on y is exactly translation by F3. Independent enumeration, including with alternative monic field moduli x+2, x^2+2x+2, x^3+2x^2+2x+2, x^4+2x^3+2x^2+x+2, gave affine counts 6,18,27,90 and projective counts 7,19,28,91. The alternative moduli were certified by every nonzero element satisfying u^(3^n-1)=1 in the quotient. Newton identities for sums (-3,-9,0,-9) and Weil reciprocity give (1,3,9,18,36,54,81,81,81); direct multiplication gives the displayed factors. Coefficient valuations are (0,1,2,2,2,3,4,4,4), above or on the endpoint line of slope 1/2. Theorem 1.1 of the same primary paper excludes smaller positive genera at 3-rank zero with full geometric C3; genus zero has infinite automorphism group. Thus supersingular existence at genus four gives sharp minimality. The uploaded certificate was inspected, not executed.
residual_risks: Counts are exhaustive only in the four listed extensions; the Weil functional equation and Newton-polygon calculation are essential. Supersingularity does not assert superspeciality.

originality.rationale: The exact curve, full geometric C3, and the genus-four lower bound for 3-rank-zero curves with this group were already known. The distinct evidence is the exact prime-field zeta numerator and resulting supersingular witness attaining that bound, a characteristic-three least-genus case of Tafazolian–Kazemifard Question 7.5. The closest same-date Artin–Schreier result concerns a different ordinary curve; a later catalog result computes numerators of distinct 3-rank-two models. The related standard-form and moduli results inspected do not specialize to the claimed numerator. No exact table match was established in the checked material; priority is not certified.
residual_risks: General search was deferred; the database search is not a comprehensive census of finite-field curve tables. An unindexed equivalent or broader Newton-polygon result could exist.

value.rationale: The model is singled out before computation by its minimal geometric automorphism group and the known lower genus bound. The exact numerator gives usable arithmetic data for that model, certifies all slopes rather than only rank zero, and answers the least-genus existence instance of the prior question for characteristic three. The useful content is not a generic point-count routine or repetition of the group computation.
residual_risks: One realization and one sharp minimum, not a classification across genera, other primes or superspecial models.
